limitations: Two independent launches per arm; exploratory, not a broad stability guarantee.
One APU, fixed synthetic inputs and 128-token outputs; no warm cache, concurrency, vision, or Agent task-quality claim.
Prefill/decode are engine steady-clock phase times. Full request is client wall time excluding process startup, loading, tokenization and cleanup.
Pinning applies only to the large FP32 indexer projection; it does not eliminate clocks, temperature, OS activity or all kernel-choice variation.

microbenchmarks.method: Synthetic fixed seeds; complete device-output byte comparisons twice per case; guards, finite output and read-only input checks. HIP event intervals average three launches; rotating arms within each block. Second process is a replicate, not another machine.
limitations: Microbench event timings are not prefill or task speedups.

Three nonpositive HIP event intervals were returned with success status. Raw values are retained; comparisons discard a block only when either side of that pair is invalid. Their underlying timer cause is not established.
Final device arrays were checked by the fail-closed probes; arrays were not separately retained for independent recomparison.
The standalone down probe first tested BN32, then was expanded to the actual BN64 long-prefill family. Do not treat BN32 changes as the 8192-row dispatch.

captures.scope: Full captured cold input streams and last-row d_R/full target logits at common absolute endpoints only. Single-sided intermediate endpoints are not compared. No full KV/GDN/MTP state, all hidden rows, unrecorded boundaries, general answer correctness, or timing equivalence.
